title: Grade 3 Math — Mon, Jun 16
description: Decimals — Day 1 of 5: Introduction to tenths
subject: mathematics

questions.question: A decimal number is a number that has a ___.
questions.explanation: A decimal number has a decimal point (.) separating the whole number part from the fractional part.

questions.question: In the number 3.7, what does the digit 7 represent?
questions.explanation: In 3.7, the digit after the decimal point is in the tenths place. 7 tenths = 7/10.

questions.question: How do you read the decimal 0.5?
questions.explanation: 0.5 is read as 'zero point five' = five tenths = 5/10 = 1/2.

questions.question: 1/10 written as a decimal is:
questions.explanation: 1/10 = one tenth = 0.1. The 1 goes in the tenths place (first place after decimal).

questions.question: How many tenths are in the whole number 1?
Write 6 tenths as a decimal:
questions.explanation: 6 tenths = 6/10 = 0.6. Six tenths goes in the first decimal place.

questions.question: What is the value of the decimal 2.4?
questions.explanation: 2.4 = 2 ones + 4 tenths. We read it as 'two point four'.

questions.question: A piece of ribbon is 1.5 m long. That means it is 1 metre and ___ tenths of a metre.
questions.explanation: 1.5 = 1 whole + 5 tenths. The ribbon is 1 metre and 5 tenths (half) of a metre.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: 0.8 = ___ tenths.
questions.explanation: 0.8 = 8 tenths. The 8 is in the tenths place.

questions.question: A pizza is cut into 10 equal slices. Riya eats 3 slices. What decimal fraction did she eat?
questions.explanation: 3 out of 10 slices = 3/10 = 0.3. She ate 0.3 of the pizza.

questions.question: Asha scored 8.6 on a test. The 6 is in the ___ place.
questions.explanation: In 8.6, the digit after the decimal point is in the tenths place. 6 is in the tenths place.

questions.question: 0.5 is the same as which fraction?
questions.explanation: 0.5 = 5/10 = 1/2. Half a whole number as a decimal is 0.5.

questions.question: How is the decimal point related to the place-value system?
options: It separates the whole number part from the fractional part
It is only used in currency
questions.explanation: The decimal point separates whole numbers (left) from fractional parts (right). Digits to the right are tenths, hundredths, etc.
